name: jobwatch
description: Run your job search from Claude: watch the job boards of companies you name (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and more), rank the new roles into a daily digest, track every application through to an offer, and get ready for interviews. Your data stays in a file on your computer. Never applies for you.

watchlist.title: Watchlist file
watchlist.description: The YAML file that lists the companies to watch. It's created the first time you add a company; point this at an existing one to keep using it.
